      "cases": [
        {
          "input": [
            {
              "parameter": "in",
              "value": "null"
            },
            {
              "parameter": "inPos",
              "value": "0"

              "parameter": "inAvail",
              "value": "0"

              "parameter": "context",
              "value": {
                "eof": true,
                "pos": 0,
                "currentLinePos": 0,
                "modulus": 0,
                "ibitWorkArea": 0
              }
            }
          ],
          "expected": "Context unchanged (pos == 0, eof == true). No bytes are written to the internal buffer.",
          "description": "When the context already signals EOF, encode must return immediately without touching the buffer."
        }
      ]
    },
